name: Dandelion Anthaxia Beetle
desc: Dandelion Anthaxia Beetle (Anthaxia inornata): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 15 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Anthaxia inornata is a species of metallic wood-boring beetle in the family Buprestidae, found in North America. It was described by Randall in 1838.
